# RustConf 2026 Keynote Highlights

Note Recorded: August 30, 2026
Conference Date: August 18, 2026

## Highlights from August 18 Sessions
- Talk on "Async Cancellation Hazards": Never assume a future runs to completion; cleanup must be placed in `Drop` implementations.
- New developments in Rust 2026 edition and compile-time ergonomics.
